info.title: GSellers Seller API v2
info.description:
Snapshot of the public GSellers docs at https://seller.ggsel.com/docs, reconstructed on 2026-11-06 from the Docusaurus build (docusaurus-plugin-openapi-docs 5.2.0). The site is generated from swaggers/swagger-seller.yaml and swaggers/swagger-seller-v2.yaml. Those yaml files are not published. Base URL is the host used by the documentation code samples. V2 sends the seller API key in the Authorization header with no Bearer prefix. Permissions all or api_sellers/v2 cover this contour.

This API uses api key for auth that is issued from seller admin page. Either `all` or specific `api_sellers/v2` permissions will work
